new_admission_food_targets.biological_mechanism: Maintain epithelial tight junction integrity and selective permeability at the gut lining.
limitations: Glutamine is supplied substantially from endogenous and systemic pools and becomes conditionally indispensable under stress; adult supplementation trials show no overall permeability benefit, so dietary protein or glutamine provision is not established as a general PM1 lever. A separate postinfectious IBS trial supports a selected supplementation response; this does not establish general need. The new Capacity assessment admits supply to junction-supporting cellular capacity, without asserting universal dietary limitation, benefit from extra intake, or equivalence to the supplemental exposure.

new_admission_food_targets.biological_mechanism: Adjust community substrate-processing capacity through resource competition and changes in microbial function.
new_admission_food_targets.food_material: Authenticated Cichorium intybus market taproots; isolated inulin characterised

food_evidence.statement: Primary isolation from chicory taproot identified beta-(2,1) fructan by FTIR and reported extracted inulin degree of polymerisation 26.

new_admission_food_targets.preparation: Taproots dehydrated at 40°C, followed by laboratory extraction; qualitative source, not a household preparation protocol
limitations: Utilisation genes, chain length, alternative substrates and resident organisms constrain the response. A supplied inulin substrate is not an indispensable intake, a guaranteed abundance shift, butyrate yield, mucus effect or clinical benefit.
Extraction/product characterisation, not a fresh-food serving assay or efficacy study. No root quantity, retention during cooking, or response equivalent to purified inulin inferred.

new_admission_food_targets.biological_mechanism: Maintain gut-to-brain nerve signalling through the vagus nerve and enteric nervous system.

food_evidence.limitations: USDA FoodData Central reports linoleic acid in Nuts, almonds.

limitations: This is physiological nutrient sensing, not a beneficial direction or a need to increase linoleic acid. Human food-level circuit responses, vagal tone, ADHD and clinical benefits were not established. Foods generally supply esterified fatty acids released during digestion; the experimental free-fatty-acid stimulus is not a demonstrated food effect. More signalling is not automatically better.
